title: Amazon PPC Lead Generator
description: Automated workflow that scrapes agency websites to detect outdated WordPress versions.

full_details.problem: The client was manually visiting hundreds of marketing agency websites, inspecting source code to find outdated WordPress versions to pitch their services. It took them 15 hours a week.
full_details.solution: I built an n8n workflow that accepts a list of domains, scrapes the homepage HTML, uses a Regex pattern to identify the WP version, and filters out anyone running the latest patch.
full_details.result: Reduced 15 hours of manual work to a 10-minute weekly review. Client closed 2 deals in the first week.

title: LinkedIn Profile Scraper
description: A custom tool bypassing standard bot detection to scrape public profile data at scale.

full_details.problem: Standard scrapers get blocked by LinkedIn's auth-wall immediately. I needed a way to gather public data without triggering anti-bot flags.
full_details.solution: I architected a Chrome Extension that piggybacks on the user's active session cookies, sending data to a local Python server which cleans and stores it in CSV format.
full_details.result: Capable of scraping 500+ profiles per hour with 0% ban rate during testing.

title: AI Invoice Processing Agent
description: An intelligent agent that reads PDF invoices and extracts key data.

full_details.problem: Small business owner was manually typing invoice data into Excel. OCR tools were too expensive or inaccurate with handwritten notes.
full_details.solution: Connected Gmail to n8n. When a PDF arrives, it's sent to GPT-4o with a vision prompt to extract 'Total Amount', 'Vendor', and 'Due Date', then formatted into JSON.
full_details.result: 100% accuracy on typed invoices. 90% accuracy on handwritten notes. Fully automated data entry.
